title: Android organizer lab
tagline: TaskMate, Taskora, TaskZen, Priorio, PlanFlow, MyAgenda, SmartDay, SmartDailyOrganizer, FlowNote — one shelf, not nine case studies.
overview: A cluster of Java Android organizer experiments published the same day on Codeberg. Grouped so the portfolio does not pretend each to-do clone is a flagship product. Notely and King Chess stay separate because they are different jobs.
problem: Nine near-identical productivity apps would dilute real shipped work.
solution: One open-source lab entry linking the family, with TaskMate as the representative URL.
architecture: Independent Java Android repos on Codeberg under ammarshamea123.
features: Honest grouping instead of inflated case studies
challenges: Naming a dozen apps in one week without a shared design system
lessonsLearned: Lab pages exist so product pages can stay sharp
futureImprovements: Pick one organizer and finish it; archive the rest
results: Visitors see a lab, not a fake 9-product streak
